2 Judicature (Amendment) Act, No. 8 of 2026

Judicature (Amendment) Act, No. 8 of 2026 3
[Certified on 06th of March, 2026]
L.D.-O 38/2024
An Act to Amend the JudicAture Act, No. 2 of 1978
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1. This Act may be cited as the Judicature (Amendment) Act, Short title
No. 8 of 2026.
2. Section 9 of the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978 is hereby Amendment
amended, by the repeal of paragraph (d) of subsection (1) of that of section 9 of
Act, No. 2 of
section, and substitution therefor, of the following paragraph:-
1978
“(d) any offence committed by any person on the high seas
where-
(i) such offence is piracy by the law of nations; or
(ii) such offence is an offence under the Poisons,
Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance
(Chapter 218), Conventions Against Illicit
Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic
Substances Act, No. 1 of 2008 or any such
written law;”.
3. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Sinhala text
Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail. to prevail
in case of
inconsistency
